subject.title: fix(gateway): force exit on zombie shutdown + 503 healthz during shutdown

question: After preserving startup-failure exit status, should Gateway retain this close-handler watchdog and configurable timeout as a separate permanent zombie-recovery contract?
rationale: The exit-status defect is mechanical, but permanent process-exit ownership and a new operator-facing environment surface require explicit lifecycle and product intent.

options.title: Fix and retain watchdog
options.body: Preserve explicit terminal status, prove every lifecycle mode, and land after Gateway owners approve the guarded watchdog and environment option.

options.title: Keep timeout internal
options.body: Preserve terminal status but remove the environment override to avoid adding a supported operator configuration contract.

options.title: Consolidate exit ownership
options.body: Move zombie termination under the existing CLI fatal-exit path instead of maintaining a second process-exit policy.

recommendation.title: Fix and retain watchdog
recommendation.body: Preserve explicit terminal status, prove every lifecycle mode, and land after Gateway owners approve the guarded watchdog and environment option.

likelyOwner.reason: The most directly relevant recent merged work establishes Gateway fatal-configuration, crash-loop, and terminal exit semantics.
